finding: Trimmed next_task_id used for lookup but original untrimmed ID retained for same-batch conflict checks.
fix: Store required_text-normalized ID in the proposal before lookup and conflict detection.
live_result_scope: Final six live cases used valid unpadded IDs and no conflicting same-batch task update/checkpoint pair. Both later guards are covered by deterministic regressions; no claim of a live rerun on final submitted source.

second_finding.finding: Implicit next_step title reuse could be followed by a same-batch completion/rename, invalidating the verified next step; renaming into the next-step title could also duplicate tasks.
second_finding.discovery: Read-only second-agent code review identified the path; primary agent reproduced it with regression tests.
second_finding.fix: Reject any checkpoint whose next-step title matches either the old or new title of a same-batch updated task, independent of order.
